semanticBinding.targetDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Verbrennungsreaktionen verschiedener Kohlenwasserstoffe vergleichen und energetische Kennzahlen auf einer gemeinsamen Bezugsbasis im jeweiligen Nutzungskontext begründet einordnen.
semanticBinding.targetDescriptionEn: The learner can compare combustion reactions of different hydrocarbons and give a reasoned interpretation of energy figures on a common reference basis in the respective context of use.

checks.finding: CH4 has 1 C and 4 H; C3H8 has 3 C and 8 H. Both named fuels are hydrocarbons.
CO2 and H2O product icons are chemically correct. Shared footer identifies types; it has no reaction arrow, balancing coefficients or equal-quantity claim.
Both rows declare 1 kg fuel. Brennwert explicitly specifies liquid water; MJ values are released combustion energy on that basis.
Both bars start on aligned zero baselines with identical 0-60 MJ scales. The modest visual ratio agrees with 55.6/50.5; no broken or cropped axis.

55.6 and 50.5 MJ for 1 kg are rounded HHV teaching values consistent with approximately 890 kJ/mol divided by 16 g/mol and 2220 kJ/mol divided by 44 g/mol. These are not measured commercial-fuel-batch claims.
No ethanol, unsupported CO2 ranking, efficiency, lifecycle or climate superiority claim appears.
Actually viewed native 1672x941. All principal text, molecule counts, values and scales are clear.
Actually viewed 680x383. Title, 1 kg condition, fuel names and formulas, MJ values and liquid-water footer are readily legible; no clipping or overlap.
Actually viewed 360x203. Principal comparison condition, fuel names, values and short footer labels remain readable. Fine tick labels are secondary and no essential explanation relies on microtype.
Friendly blue cartoon styling, large familiar objects and concise labels support the school-level qualitative goal without a crowded table.

Supports one mass/Brennwert comparison and complete-combustion product types. It is a worked illustration and does not by itself prove independent learner reaction-equation or use-context-transfer performance.

adoptionQualificationDe: Gerundete illustrative Brennwerte je 1 kg der genannten reinen Kohlenwasserstoffe; Produktwasser flüssig. Nutzwärme, CO2-Mengen und Umweltwirkung benötigen jeweils zusätzliche Bezugsgrößen und Systemgrenzen.
adoptionQualificationEn: Rounded illustrative higher heating values per 1 kg of the named pure hydrocarbons; product water liquid. Useful heat, CO2 amounts and environmental effects each require further reference quantities and system boundaries.
